about.title: DB Chatbot
about.subtitle: Analyze public data using natural language
about.welcomeP1: The BD chatbot helps you talk to your data in a simple, intuitive way, making it easier to understand your information and uncover insights.
about.welcomeP2: To get started, click New chat in the left menu and send a message.
about.welcomeP3: Not sure where to start? Try asking what data is available on your research topic. From there, you can explore the data, ask new questions, and deepen your analysis.
about.welcomeP5: It all starts with a good question.
about.contact: Need help or have a question? Reach out to us by email at suporte.bdpro@basedosdados.org or join our community on Discord and WhatsApp.

findData.title: Data search

export.body: Exports query results to download in .csv, .parquet, .avro, or .jsonl formats.

about.promptGuideIntro: How you talk to the chatbot can influence the quality of the answers. That's why we've gathered a few tips to help you write your questions and get better results.
promptTips: Try asking one question at a time. If your question is too complex or involves several issues, try splitting it into smaller, simpler questions.
When in doubt, ask the chatbot itself for help. It can help you understand which data is available, suggest lines of analysis, and explain an answer better.
If the chatbot isn't finding the answer you're looking for and you know which table holds the data you need, try pointing to that table explicitly in your question.
